phase_name: status, the Union Check, and the Repo-Agnosticism Assertion

objectives.description: Implement status: local ref vs recorded commit, remote tracking ref vs recorded commit, content-based merged test
status reports the state vocabulary already in the schema and names a rebuild due for an unmerged slice whose base has moved, printing only, pushing/merging nothing
Add the union check to the suite
Add the repo-agnosticism static assertion (no literal default remote/branch name)
Add the no-dependency static assertion (no source/invocation of review-stack-prepare.sh or any script outside lib/ and deploy-root-guard.sh)
Add status cases: built-but-unpushed; pushed-and-matching; pushed-and-diverging; squash-merged by content; rebuild due on moved base

deviations.reason: The assertion's grep over 'review-stack-prepare' initially matched the script's own explanatory comment stating the decision NOT to depend on review-stack-prepare.sh (a legitimate, intentional comment, not a real dependency). Narrowed the grep to exclude pure-comment lines (`grep -v '^[0-9]*:#'`), the exact exclusion convention the Phase 1 static push/checkout/forge assertion already uses for the same reason.
deviations.annotation: *(completed: deviation -- excluded pure-comment lines from the review-stack-prepare grep, matching the Phase 1 static assertion's own comment-exclusion convention)*

deviations.description: Remote-tracking-ref test fixtures use git update-ref, never git push
deviations.reason: git push is blocked unconditionally by this environment's guard hook (guard-git-push.sh), including against a throwaway local bare/fixture remote with no network or forge involvement -- the hook pattern-matches the command text regardless of destination. Status's own test cases for 'pushed and matching' / 'pushed and diverging' instead fabricate the resulting refs/remotes/<remote>/... ref directly via `git update-ref`, which is not blocked and is sufficient since the script itself only ever reads that ref's value (it never pushes).
deviations.annotation: *(completed: deviation -- remote-tracking-ref fixtures built via git update-ref, not git push, since git push is unconditionally guard-blocked in this environment even for a local throwaway fixture)*
